highlight.title: Recognized among Snowflake's top partners
highlight.body: Viewnear is a Snowflake Premier Partner, recognized in Snowflake's CoCo Preferred Partner program. At Snowflake Summit 2026 we were featured among the partners driving the most momentum on Snowflake CoCo, the data-native coding agent, out of 1,300+ worldwide, alongside firms like Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, and Capgemini.
